g.text: Filled: 1,000,000 distinct inputs; open: recorded smaller prefix. Native timing scopes differ.
Recorded platform: Linux / x86_64; structured backend: avx512vl. Hardware equivalence to the manuscript is not asserted.
Each setting is paired on one host; collection spans ares1, ares2, ares3, ares4, ares5, ares6. See canonical.json.
